content: Hello, I am Cedar Insurance's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Rory Wood?
Yes, this is Rory Wood speaking.
Before we continue, I need to confirm your identity. Could you please tell me your policyholder code?
Could you please tell me your postcode?
Thank you. I am calling about overdue insurance premiums. Your insurance policy has 480.00 past due and is 3 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amount today?
Yes, I can pay the 480 today. But if I agree, am I insured again from today?
I'm sorry, I don't have that information. To confirm: the insurance policy, 480.00 on Wednesday 14 October 2026. Do you confirm this?

Okay, so I understand this just records my promise to pay 480 today and doesn't tell me whether my cover is back. On that basis, yes, I confirm the 480 on 14 October, but could I speak to a person about whether I'm actually covered?
Your promise is recorded: the insurance policy, 480.00 on Wednesday 14 October 2026. A premium-promise receipt will be placed in the secure inbox. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Thanks. Yes, I'd still like to speak to a person about whether my cover is actually active, since you weren't able to tell me that. Can you put me through or arrange a callback?
I will connect you with a colleague now. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
